name: Aiera
website_summary: Aiera is a permissioned content platform that gives investment professionals compliant, auditable access to broker research, expert insights, event transcripts, filings, and financial news through APIs, an MCP server, and dashboard tools. It is built for asset managers, hedge funds, and other institutional investors who need to integrate proprietary sell-side research into their AI workflows.
linkedin_product_summary: Aiera's MCP server connects LLMs to its proprietary financial content library, delivering an average 2.4x improvement on financial research questions that the open web cannot answer, tested across 13 models. The platform also publishes an LLM leaderboard that benchmarks model performance specifically on broker research tasks, and delivers content via enterprise APIs with connectors for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Microsoft Azure.
linkedin_other_summary: Aiera closed a $25M Series B in 2025, backed by a consortium of ten major Wall Street banks including Bank of America, Barclays, Citi, Deutsche Bank, and UBS, plus expert network Third Bridge, with Microsoft as a strategic technology partner. The company has been active at industry events including BattleFin Discovery Day NYC and Unbundling Uncovered NYC, and recently appointed Eric Lebovich, CFA, formerly of Point72, AlphaSense, Bloomberg, and FactSet, as Head of Product Management.
primary_user_summary: Equity research analysts and investment professionals at buy-side firms use Aiera daily to search, retrieve, and analyze permissioned broker research, earnings transcripts, expert network content, and filings through AI-powered tools integrated into their existing workflows.

name: Ahead Innovation Labs
website_summary: Ahead Innovation Labs sells a generative simulation platform that creates synthetic financial market data for stress-testing investment strategies, validating quant models, and analyzing risk scenarios beyond what historical data covers. It is built for institutional investors, portfolio managers, and quant research teams at hedge funds and financial institutions.
linkedin_product_summary: The platform generates thousands of synthetic price paths conditioned on macroeconomic factors and volatility regimes, allowing risk teams to stress-test portfolios against correlation spikes, tail events, and market regimes not present in historical data. It is positioned as a solution to the core limitation of backtesting — that historical data cannot capture future crises.
linkedin_other_summary: Ahead Innovation Laboratories was awarded a research grant from Innosuisse to collaborate with the University of Lucerne's Applied AI Research Lab on advancing synthetic data for quantitative trading. Posts also include thought leadership on quantitative finance topics such as correlation breakdown, model risk, and the limits of backtesting.
primary_user_summary: Risk managers and quant researchers at hedge funds and institutional asset managers use this platform to stress-test portfolios and validate models against synthetic market scenarios — including correlation spikes and tail events — that historical data does not contain.

name: Alphasense
website_summary: AlphaSense sells an AI-powered market intelligence and search platform that gives business and financial professionals fast access to insights from 500M+ documents including filings, broker research, expert transcripts, and internal content. It is built for teams in investment banking, hedge funds, private equity, asset management, consulting, and large corporates who need to research markets, companies, and competitors.
linkedin_product_summary: AlphaSense recently launched Sentiment Indices that convert executive and analyst language from earnings transcripts into quantifiable signals, and introduced SuperAnalyst, an always-on AI agent that autonomously handles research workflows and produces executive-ready reports. The platform also added Connectors to integrate tools like Outlook, Slack, Notion, and Gong with its 500M+ document library for unified research.
linkedin_other_summary: AlphaSense hosted multiple webinars on AI investing stacks, private markets alpha generation, and AI in investment banking workflows, featuring guests from firms like Rangeley Capital, BNY, and Deutsche Bank. The company also announced a new headquarters at Hudson Yards in New York City and published thought leadership on AI adoption concerns.
primary_user_summary: Research analysts at hedge funds, asset managers, investment banks, and large corporates are the primary daily users, relying on AlphaSense to search and synthesize earnings transcripts, broker research, filings, and expert content to support investment and strategic decisions.

name: Auquan
website_summary: Auquan sells AI agents that automate end-to-end knowledge workflows—credit analysis, ESG screening, LP reporting, and compliance—for institutional finance teams at banks, private credit funds, and asset managers. The software takes raw data and produces ready-to-review outputs, cutting tasks that previously took days down to minutes or hours.
linkedin_product_summary: Auquan's AI agents handle the data gathering, reconciliation, and document assembly work in private credit deal screening and portfolio monitoring, so analysts focus only on judgment calls like credit evaluation and investment decisions. The platform processes data from over two million sources in 76+ languages and delivers outputs matched to a firm's own templates and standards.
linkedin_other_summary: Auquan is actively sponsoring and presenting at industry conferences including SuperReturn International in Berlin, where CEO Chandini Jain moderated a private debt panel, and is hosting networking events for IIT alumni during New York Tech Week with investors Susquehanna Venture Capital and Neotribe Ventures. The company is hiring across engineering, product, and sales in New York and London, and launched a Global Innovation Roadshow of working sessions with large funds and banks.
primary_user_summary: Credit analysts and investment professionals at private credit funds, banks, and asset managers use Auquan daily to automate deal screening, credit memo generation, and portfolio monitoring, replacing manual data gathering with agent-produced outputs ready for their review.

name: Batonics
website_summary: Batonics sells AI-powered tools for quantitative investment analysis, including orderbook microstructure analysis, backtesting infrastructure, Monte Carlo simulation, risk modeling, and automated valuation — targeting hedge funds, HFT firms, family offices, and other institutional investors.
linkedin_product_summary: Batonics has built the Quantoscope, a Rust-based platform that reconstructs L3 orderbooks from Databento MBO feeds, engineers 108+ microstructure features, and supports backtesting with latency simulation. They also offer Loha AI, which includes formal verification for low-latency trading code (C++, Rust, FPGA, etc.) using theorem-proving tools like Z3 and CBMC.
linkedin_other_summary: Batonics announced a pilot MoU with GAO Capital, a Singapore-based regulated hedge fund, to develop quant research infrastructure and discover proprietary trading algorithms using microstructure analysis across energy and equity futures.
primary_user_summary: Quantitative researchers and data engineers at hedge funds and HFT firms use Batonics to reconstruct and analyze L3 orderbook data, engineer microstructure features, and build and backtest trading strategies.
